rv.q: Hundred Days is a deeply autobiographical piece telling the Bengsons’ love story.
Nonetheless, its dynamically joyous score and gripping theme create a unique concert experience audiences will enjoy.

Hundred Days, with autobiographical music and lyrics by husband-and-wife Shaun and Abigail Bengson , is a spirited and soulful folk musical now in its DC-area premiere at Dupont Circle’s Keegan Theatre.
The self-described folk-punk score is the standout feature of married couple Abigail and Shaun Bengson’s autobiographical odyssey into their love story and life leading their family band.
In the dark days of October, Hundred Days provides a welcome dose of comfort and joy.
